description: This file implements the BaseOutputTransport class for Pipecat, handling audio/video output processing, buffering, mixing, timing, media streaming, and interruption handling. It manages multiple output destinations and includes nested MediaSender classes for per-destination media handling.

classes.name: BaseOutputTransport
classes.description: A base class for output transport implementations managing audio/video processing, buffering, timing, and multiple destinations.

classes.name: BaseOutputTransport.MediaSender
classes.description: Handles media streaming for a specific destination, managing buffering, timing, and frame delivery.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the transport, sets sample rate and chunk size based on start frame.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all media senders and cleans up resources.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Immediately cancels all processing and stops media senders.

methods.name: set_transport_ready
methods.description: Configures destinations and starts media senders when transport is ready.

methods.name: write_dtmf
methods.description: Handles DTMF tone output, using native support if available or generating audio otherwise.
